title: the backup schedule depended on a cron daemon the box may lack

findings.claim: the backup schedule was a cron file only: on a host with no cron daemon the nightly backup never ran and doctor's backup check passed
findings.severity_basis: no backup is taken on such a box and nothing says so until the age alert, which also never runs from cron
findings.fix: backup-install writes each cron line as a systemd timer where systemd is the init and removes the cron file; doctor and backup-status name the schedule and the action; tests/unit/test_backup_schedule_timer.py
findings.from: the integrator's card H-92 (comment 7088635278) and the bench's rehearsal host, 2026-11-23

findings.claim: /etc/cron.d/trialbox-retention (log retention and the signed audit head) has the same dependence on a cron daemon, and install.sh writes it only where /etc/cron.d exists
findings.severity_basis: logs are not pruned and no audit head is signed; doctor's audit_heads FAILs on the age without naming the cause

findings.claim: backup-status's exit code does not carry a missing schedule; only doctor FAILs on it
findings.severity_basis: the hourly check cannot run without a schedule anyway; a person running it by hand reads the schedule line
findings.fix: changing the exit code changes what test_cli_status_exit_codes asserts on a host with /etc/cron.d: needs a ruling
